name: Runge-Kutta 4 (RK4) Integration
definition: A method to solve the initial value problem for a point xi in an unsteady vector field by taking four samples from the vector field in the neighborhood of xi and calculating xi+1 using a weighted sum.
summary: Runge-Kutta 4 integration computes ray-marching steps using four vector field samples to achieve significantly higher accuracy than Euler methods, trading increased computation for reduced trajectory error.
